articles.title: Amazon joins the $3 trillion club as AI and cloud growth fuel historic rally
articles.summary: Amazon's market value reaches $3 trillion, driven by its cloud computing business and artificial intelligence capabilities.
articles.detail: The company's cloud computing arm, Amazon Web Services (AWS), has been a key driver of its growth. AWS provides a range of services including computing power, storage, databases, analytics, machine learning, and more.

articles.title: Wall Street Raises Amazon Targets After Its AWS Surge. Here’s The Number.
articles.summary: Analysts raise their price targets for Amazon following the company's strong quarterly earnings report, driven by growth in its cloud computing business.
articles.detail: Amazon's cloud computing arm, Amazon Web Services (AWS), reported its fastest growth in 18 quarters, leading analysts to increase their price targets for the company.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6
articles.summary: Azure announces the public preview of Azure Private Link support over IPv6, enabling private access to Azure PaaS services.
articles.detail: The feature allows customers to use IPv6 private endpoints to connect from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network to Azure PaaS services such as Azure Storage and Azure SQL Database.

articles.title: Nvidia at $190: A Clear Evolution and a Reasonable Entry Point Create a Bullish Opportunity
articles.summary: Analyst sees Nvidia's recent pullback as a buying opportunity, citing the company's strong growth prospects in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.
articles.detail: The analyst notes that Nvidia's revenue growth has accelerated despite the recent pullback in its stock price, making it an attractive investment opportunity.

articles.title: Measuring network latency to AWS Region before deployment
articles.summary: AWS provides guidance on measuring network latency to its regions, helping customers choose the best region for their workloads.
articles.detail: The company notes that choosing the right region can be complex and requires careful consideration of various factors including network latency, data sovereignty, and regulatory requirements.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
articles.summary: Azure announces the general availability of its virtual network routing appliance, enabling private connectivity across virtual networks.
articles.detail: The feature provides a highly available and scalable solution for routing traffic between virtual networks, using specialized hardware for low latency and high throughput.

articles.title: What’s new with Google Cloud
articles.summary: Google Cloud provides an overview of its latest updates, announcements, and resources.
articles.detail: The company highlights its latest innovations in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and cloud computing, as well as new resources for developers and customers.

articles.title: NVIDIA Joins NSF State and Regional AI Hubs Program to Expand AI Research and Education Across the US
articles.summary: Nvidia joins a National Science Foundation program aimed at expanding access to artificial intelligence research and education across the United States.
articles.detail: The company will provide advanced computing, data, software, and expertise to support AI-enabled research and education in various regions of the country.

articles.title: Cloud CISO Perspectives: Why AI Threat Defense is the new boardroom baseline
articles.summary: Google Cloud's Chief Information Security Officer discusses the importance of artificial intelligence in threat defense and its implications for business leaders.
articles.detail: The CISO notes that AI-powered threat defense is becoming a standard requirement for businesses, and that boards of directors need to understand the risks and opportunities associated with AI in security governance.

articles.title: How Deutsche Bank unlocked agility with an API-ready ecosystem
articles.summary: Deutsche Bank discusses its approach to digital transformation, highlighting the importance of APIs in enabling modern banking services.
articles.detail: The bank notes that APIs are essential for creating a flexible and scalable infrastructure that can support innovative financial services and improve customer experience.

articles.title: Introducing the Billable Usage API: programmatic cost visibility for Cloudflare
articles.summary: Cloudflare announces a new API for tracking billable usage across its products, providing developers and FinOps teams with single-endpoint visibility into cost and usage.
articles.detail: The API is built around the FOCUS specification and allows customers to track spend seamlessly across all self-serve products.

articles.title: From Chips to Ships: Why Nvidia’s Move into Shipbuilding Matters
articles.summary: Nvidia's move into shipbuilding is seen as a significant development in the use of artificial intelligence in manufacturing.
articles.detail: The company's AI capabilities are expected to improve productivity and efficiency in the complex and labor-intensive process of shipbuilding.

articles.title: The Chatbot Felt Like AI's Debut — It Was Actually the Simplest Part
articles.summary: The development of chatbots is seen as a key milestone in the evolution of artificial intelligence, but it was actually one of the simpler applications of AI.
articles.detail: More complex applications of AI, such as those in manufacturing and healthcare, are expected to have a much greater impact on society.

articles.title: The 2026 QSR 50: Fast Food’s Leading Annual Report
articles.summary: QSR magazine releases its annual report on the fast food industry, highlighting trends and leaders in the sector.
articles.detail: The report provides insights into consumer behavior, menu innovation, and marketing strategies in the fast food industry.

articles.title: IT Teams Report 11 Hour a Week on Cloud Connectivity Problems
articles.summary: Researchers find that IT teams are spending significant amounts of time troubleshooting cloud connectivity issues, driven by increased AI workloads.
articles.detail: The study highlights the need for improved cloud infrastructure and better tools for managing complex AI environments.
